title: Add Built‑in Request Validation Middleware
description: Provides automatic validation of request bodies against JSON‑schema definitions without external dependencies. This prevents malformed data from reaching route handlers, improving security and reducing boilerplate validation code.
testCases: Valid payload passes and next() is called
Invalid payload returns 400 with detailed error message
Missing schema for a route returns 500 with clear log
Validation works for both JSON and URL‑encoded bodies
acceptance: When a route registers a schema via app.validate(schema), incoming requests are validated; valid requests reach the handler, invalid requests receive a 400 response with a JSON error object. Errors are logged and do not crash the server. All new tests pass and existing test suite remains green.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the framework level, reduces repetitive validation code in applications, and aligns with the recent stability focus while keeping the zero‑dependency promise.
